welcome.title: Welcome to {{name}}
welcome.listText: Tools you use in Terminal, like Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, all in one list. Once the first check finishes, Sources in the sidebar shows how each was installed, such as Homebrew, npm or the tool's own installer; programs installed some other way are under Other Programs.
welcome.confirmTitle: You Confirm Every Update and Uninstall
welcome.confirmText: Before an update or uninstall, you see what it will do and the commands it will run. It starts only when you confirm, and it's checked again when it's done.
welcome.settingsTitle: No Shell Edits, No Data Collected
welcome.settingsText: Doesn't edit your shell's startup files; where a tool's own uninstall does, it says so first. Collects no usage data and needs no account.

warnings.removesCargoInstalled_other: Also permanently deletes {{count}} programs from the Cargo folder: {{names}}.

warnings.leavesShellConfigLineMaybeDetail: Check that line after uninstalling; if your terminal shows an error when it starts, delete it.

warnings.homebrewPeriodicCleanupDetail: Homebrew is run with HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP=1, but your brew.env sets it to nothing, and brew.env wins.
warnings.homebrewCleanupAutoremoves: Homebrew's periodic clean-up also removes other Homebrew packages that were installed only as dependencies and that nothing needs any more.
warnings.homebrewCleanupAutoremovesDetail: Homebrew is run with HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP=1 and HOMEBREW_NO_AUTOREMOVE=1, but your brew.env sets the first to nothing and the second to a value Homebrew reads as unset, such as 0 or false, and brew.env wins.

uninstallScope.HomebrewFormulaOnly: Removes only the Homebrew version of {{name}} and the links to it. Settings and data stored elsewhere are kept.
uninstallScope.HomebrewFormula: Removes the Homebrew version of {{name}} and the links to it. Settings and data stored elsewhere are kept.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskPlain: Deletes what Homebrew installed for {{name}}; its settings and data stay.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskSteps: Deletes the files Homebrew placed for {{name}} and runs the uninstall steps it recorded; nothing else is deleted.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskStepsAutoremoves: Deletes the files Homebrew placed for {{name}} and runs the uninstall steps it recorded; {{name}}'s other files stay.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskStepsUnseen: Deletes the files Homebrew placed for {{name}} and runs the uninstall steps it recorded; what else some of those steps delete can't be seen in advance.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskStepsOnly: Runs the uninstall steps Homebrew recorded for {{name}}; other files its installer put on this Mac stay.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCaskStepsOnlyUnseen: Runs the uninstall steps Homebrew recorded for {{name}}; what else some of those steps delete can't be seen in advance.
uninstallScope.HomebrewCask: Couldn't tell from Homebrew's records what uninstalling {{name}} deletes.
uninstallScope.Npm: Deletes {{name}}'s folder in npm's global folder and its commands; npm runs none of its code, so its settings and data outside that folder are not deleted.
uninstallScope.Pipx: Deletes the Python environment pipx made just for {{name}} and the commands that point into it; its settings and data outside that environment are not deleted.
uninstallScope.Uv: Deletes the Python environment uv made just for {{name}} and the commands it recorded; its settings and data outside that environment are not deleted.
uninstallScope.Cargo: Deletes the program files cargo installed for {{name}}; the download cache, Cargo's settings and the program's own settings stay.
uninstallScope.Ollama: Deletes the model {{name}}; data other models still use is kept, and Ollama itself and your other models stay.

caskStep.DeletesUnnamed: Also permanently deletes files Homebrew finds only as it runs the uninstall steps.
caskStep.DeletesLinks_one: Also permanently deletes {{items}}, but only where it is a link whose target contains “{{link}}”.
caskStep.DeletesLinks_other: Also permanently deletes these, but only where they are links whose target contains “{{link}}”: {{items}}.
caskStep.DeletesFilesContaining_one: Also permanently deletes {{items}}, but only where it is a file whose contents contain “{{content}}”.
caskStep.DeletesFilesContaining_other: Also permanently deletes these, but only where they are files whose contents contain “{{content}}”: {{items}}.
caskStep.DeletesLinksToFilesContaining_one: Also permanently deletes {{items}}, but only where it is a link whose target contains “{{link}}” and that leads to a file whose contents contain “{{content}}”.
caskStep.DeletesLinksToFilesContaining_other: Also permanently deletes these, but only where they are links whose target contains “{{link}}” and that lead to a file whose contents contain “{{content}}”: {{items}}.
caskStep.DeletesUnnamedLinks: Also permanently deletes links Homebrew finds only as it runs the uninstall steps, but only those whose target contains “{{link}}”.
caskStep.DeletesUnnamedFilesContaining: Also permanently deletes files Homebrew finds only as it runs the uninstall steps, but only those whose contents contain “{{content}}”.
caskStep.DeletesUnnamedLinksToFilesContaining: Also permanently deletes links Homebrew finds only as it runs the uninstall steps, but only those whose target contains “{{link}}” and that lead to a file whose contents contain “{{content}}”.
caskStep.Trashes_other: Also moves these to the Trash: {{items}}.
caskStep.RemovesPackages_one: Also deletes every file the installer package {{items}} put on this Mac, whether or not other apps use them.
caskStep.RemovesPackages_other: Also deletes every file these installer packages put on this Mac, whether or not other apps use them: {{items}}.
caskStep.RunsOwnSteps: Before or after uninstalling, it also runs other steps Homebrew recorded for it.
caskStep.RemovesServices_one: Also stops and removes a background service.
caskStep.RemovesServices_other: Also stops and removes {{count}} background services.
caskStep.RemovesServicesMatching: Also stops and removes background services, including every running one whose name matches a pattern.
caskStep.RemovesKexts_one: Also unloads and deletes the kernel extension {{items}}.
caskStep.RemovesKexts_other: Also unloads and deletes these kernel extensions: {{items}}.
caskStep.DeletesCertificates_one: Also deletes every certificate in the keychain whose name contains {{items}}.
caskStep.DeletesCertificates_other: Also deletes every certificate in the keychain whose name contains any of these: {{items}}.
caskStep.QuitsApps_one: Also quits an app if it is running.
caskStep.QuitsApps_other: Also quits {{count}} apps if they are running.
caskStep.QuitsAppsMatching: Also quits apps if they are running, including every app whose name matches a pattern.
caskStep.QuitsNamedApps_one: Also quits {{items}} if it is running.
caskStep.QuitsNamedApps_other: Also quits {{items}} if they are running.

sizes.ollamaModelsAtLeast: Ollama models: {{size}} or more in all

unreachable.description: {{source}} didn't respond, so what it has installed can't be shown. Check again later.

unreachable.descriptionWithModels_other: {{source}} has {{count}} models. It didn't respond this time, so they show its last answer. Check again later.
unreachable.descriptionWithOwnRow: {{source}} didn't respond this time, so what's shown is its last answer. Check again later.
unreachable.detailModels: Its models can't be listed this time. Check again later.
unreachable.detailOwn: It can't be listed this time. Check again later.

refusesAsRoot.title: {{source}} doesn't run as administrator
refusesAsRoot.description: {{source}} doesn't work when this app runs as administrator. Quit, then open Banager again with a double-click.

notRunning.title: {{source}} isn't running
notRunning.description: Open {{source}} to see what it has and check for updates.

openOllamaFailed.notInstalled: There's no Ollama app in Applications. Download it from ollama.com, install it, then click Open Ollama again.
openOllamaFailed.notInstalledDetail: The ollama command from Homebrew doesn't include the app.
openOllamaFailed.launchFailed: macOS couldn't open Ollama. Open it yourself from Applications; if that fails too, reinstall it from ollama.com.
openOllamaFailed.other: Couldn't open Ollama. Open it yourself from Applications.

indexMayBeStale.title: Couldn't update Homebrew's software list
indexMayBeStale.description: This check used the old list. Check your internet connection, then try again.

indexUpdating.title: Homebrew is updating its software list
indexUpdating.description: The Updates page shows the previous check's results. A new check starts by itself when the list finishes updating.

notOnPath.title: {{source}} is installed, but typing {{command}} in Terminal doesn't run it
notOnPath.description: It isn't in any of the places Terminal looks for commands. Open a new Terminal window and try again; if it still doesn't work, follow its installation instructions.

shadowedByHomebrew.title: Typing {{command}} in Terminal runs a program with that name from Homebrew
shadowedByHomebrew.description: Terminal finds the one from Homebrew first, not the one {{source}}'s own installer installed. Couldn't confirm whether it's another copy of {{source}}.

shadowedByNpm.title: Typing {{command}} in Terminal runs a program with that name from npm
shadowedByNpm.description: Terminal finds the one from npm first, not the one {{source}}'s own installer installed. Couldn't confirm whether it's another copy of {{source}}.

shadowedByOther.title: Typing {{command}} in Terminal runs another program with that name
shadowedByOther.description: Terminal first finds a program that couldn't be identified, not the one {{source}}'s own installer installed. If it's in Other Programs, you can see where it is there.

launcherOnly.title: {{source}}'s program files are missing
launcherOnly.description: {{command}} can't run any more: reinstall {{source}}, or put its files back from the Trash if they're there and check again. If you no longer need {{source}}, uninstall it in Installed.

checksUnfinished.title: Some checks didn't finish
checksUnfinished.description_one: {{sources}} didn't finish checking this time; some updates may not be listed yet.
checksUnfinished.description_other: {{sources}} didn't finish checking this time; some updates may not be listed yet.

httpsHostRefused.title: Connecting to Ollama over https isn't supported
httpsHostRefused.description: OLLAMA_HOST is set to an https:// address, and only http connections to Ollama are supported, so {{source}} can't be checked. If that Ollama also answers over http, change OLLAMA_HOST to its http:// address, then quit and reopen this app.

noPip.title: {{command}} doesn't include pip
noPip.description: This Python doesn't include pip, so there's nothing to list.

planRefused.sourceGone: Couldn't start because the tool that manages this can't be found. Click Check Again.
planRefused.expired: This confirmation is more than 10 minutes old, so nothing ran. Open it again and confirm.
planRefused.unknown: This confirmation is no longer valid. Close it and start again.
planRefused.outputTooLarge: {{source}} returned too much output, so this couldn't continue.
planRefused.indexUpdating: Homebrew is updating its software list, so dependencies can't be checked reliably now. Try again in a minute or two.
planRefused.refused: Couldn't continue because of an internal error.
planRefused.notListed: Couldn't start because it's no longer in the list. Click Check Again.

uninstallUnsafe.outsideHome: Couldn't move {{path}} because the folder holding it leads outside your home folder.
uninstallUnsafe.sharedFolder: Couldn't move {{path}} because it's in a folder other apps share.
uninstallUnsafe.notOwnedByYou: Couldn't move {{path}} because it belongs to another user.

operations.title: {{kind}} {{name}}

logNote.trashFailed: Couldn't move {{path}} to the Trash, so the uninstall stopped: {{error}}

logNote.backAfterUninstall: Found {{path}} at the final check and left it where it is.
